description: This Java class 'SwitchStateTableModel' extends DefaultTableModel to provide a custom table model for displaying switch states and their data in a Swing application. It handles a map of switch state names to byte array data, presenting the data as hexadecimal strings.

classes.name: SwitchStateTableModel
classes.description: A custom Swing table model for representing switch states with data as hex strings.

methods.name: getColumnCount
methods.description: Returns the number of columns, which is fixed to 2 ('Switch State' and 'State Data')

methods.name: getColumnName
methods.description: Returns the name of a given column.

methods.name: getValueAt
methods.description: Returns the value at a specific row and column, retrieving the switch state name or its data in hex form.

methods.name: getRowCount
methods.description: Returns the number of rows based on the switchStates map size.

methods.name: getColumnClass
methods.description: Returns the class type of data in the specified column.

methods.name: isCellEditable
methods.description: Indicates that cells are not editable.

methods.name: setScalesList
methods.description: Sets or updates the switchStates map with new data.
